first_page: Maps page /map/ for anyone who wants a map and a route without being tracked. First: "map of lisbon" opens a full pan-zoom OpenStreetMap map at the place; "from lisbon to porto" draws a route (car, foot, bike) with time and distance from a keyless open router, pins saved on the device, and a link holding view, pins and route. Will not build: live traffic, turn-by-turn voice, Street View, reviews or business listings.
